name: pseg
transitions: real->protected (CR0.PE 0->1, CS far-jump to 32-bit flat code segment 0x08)
segment loads (DS/ES/SS/FS/GS <- flat 0x10, DS <- based 0x18, DS <- based#2 0x28, DS <- read-only 0x20)
16-bit protected CS 0x30 executes exact CWSDPMI bytes 66 67 C5 75 10 (LDS ESI,[EBP+0x10])
description: Bare-metal real->protected SEGMENTATION-only differential. In addition to flat/based/read-only segment loads, hidden-base checks, POP DS, and limit-boundary accesses, GDT selector 0x30 enters a D=0 protected code segment and executes the exact silicon opcode bytes 66 67 C5 75 10 (LDS ESI,[EBP+0x10]). The m16:32 pointer supplies offset 0x13579BDF and based DS selector 0x18; ESI and a store through DS.base=0x20000 are observed after returning to 32-bit code. Pinned QEMU and current RTL produce 90 equivalent records. No paging; exits via isa-debug-exit status 133.
